description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kamburagala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District  (25/0067)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and legal determinations of title. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
